name: product-dashboard
prompt: Screen: Dashboard, with "Dashboard" highlighted in the sidebar. Page title "Dashboard" and subtitle "Welcome back, Alex. Here is what is happening in the system." A wide status card with a green dot and the label "Working hours", the line "Calls run 8:00 AM–5:00 PM in each lead's local time zone, Monday to Friday" and "Lines busy: 5 of 5 · Touches waiting in queue: 18". Tabs below: "Summary" (active, amber underline), "Tasks" with a count badge "12", "Progress". Period chips: "Today" (active, amber), "Week", "Month". A row of four KPI cards: "Calls" 1,284 with "reached 812 — 63%"; "Conversations" 392 with "average 1 min 12 s"; "Hot leads" 38 with "21 with a request"; "Passed to managers" 26 with "leads that got an owner". Below, a large panel "What happened" with a feed of five events, each with a small line icon, bold title, a muted company line, a one-line note and a timestamp on the right, some with rating chips: "Hot lead: asks for a quote" (Great Lakes Freight Co. — Chicago → Dallas, 3 loads a week, chip A); "Manager assigned: Sarah Collins" (Prairie Line Logistics); "Tender window opens in 9 days — reminder created" (Maple Route Carriers); "Follow-up call booked for 10:30 AM CT" (Lone Star Haulers, chip B); "Silent lead moved down to rating D" (Harbor Point Imports). Render it as a crisp, pixel-perfect desktop web-app screenshot, flat and straight-on, with no browser chrome, no device frame, no perspective and no watermark. Product: "MagnaQore Logistic", an AI calling and sales system for North American freight companies. Dark theme: page background deep warm charcoal #141311; panels and cards #1d1b18 with hairline borders #2c2925 and 12px rounded corners; primary text warm off-white #ece8e1; secondary text muted warm grey #8f8a82; one accent, amber-gold #e9a23b, used for the active navigation marker, count badges, primary buttons, progress fills, active tabs and toggles; green #3fae7a only for positive statuses; lead ratings shown as small rounded chips reading A, B, C or D. Typography: a clean geometric sans-serif similar to Manrope, calm spacing, 13–15px interface text that is sharp, legible and spelled correctly. Left sidebar about 230px wide: a small muted label "MagnaQore" above the bold product name "Logistic AI" with a bell icon; navigation with thin line icons in this order: Dashboard (small amber count badge), Contacts, Dialer, Calls, Chats, Lead gen, Assistant, Settings, Help, System; at the bottom a user block "Alex Morgan" with the role "Sales ops" and a log-out icon. All people, companies, phone numbers and figures are fictional; phone numbers use the US 555 range. English only.
